story.text: “Sentence first, {VERDICT} afterwards,” says the Queen. “Stuff and {NONSENSE}!” says Alice, who has grown to her full {SIZE}. “Who cares for you? You’re nothing but a pack of {CARDS}!” The whole pack rises up into the {AIR} and comes flying down upon her, and she {WAKES} on the bank, with her head in her sister’s {LAP}. What a curious {DREAM} it has been!
story.caption: The shower of cards
story.credit: John Tenniel, coloured for The Nursery “Alice”, 1890
